title: Cookie Policy
description: Which cookies and browser storage SecureKit uses. Currently none, with notes on future advertising cookies.
body:
SecureKit does not set cookies. It stores only your theme choice, favorite tool IDs and recently used tool IDs in your browser's localStorage, never tool inputs.

If advertising is added

Google AdSense may place cookies or use similar technologies to serve and measure ads. In that case this policy, the privacy policy and any required consent mechanism should be updated before ads go live.

Managing cookies

You can control cookies in your browser settings.
